Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 spon_count number ;
 x boolean ;
begin
 if :donors.spon_id is null or length( :donors.spon_id ) < 3 then
 show_error('11330');
 check_package_failure ;
 end if;

 select count(*) 
 into spon_count 
 from sponsors
 where ( sponsor_id = :donors.spon_id 
 or upper(name) like '%'||upper(:donors.spon_id)||'%')
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 if spon_count = 0 then
 show_error('11142') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif spon_count = 1 then
 begin
 select sponsor_id, name 
 into :donors.spon_id, :donors.credit_sponsor
 from sponsors
 where ( sponsor_id = :donors.spon_id 
 or upper(name) like '%'||upper(:donors.spon_id)||'%')
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 next_item ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 elsif spon_count > 1 then
 x := show_lov('SPON_LOV') ;
 if not X then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if ;
exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
end ;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_spon_id Varchar2(10);
 v_spon_name varchar2(300);
 v_cre_spon_id Varchar2(10);
 v_cre_spon_name varchar2(300);
 dtLabDt date;
 
begin
 -- get drive sponsor and alternate sponsor id for this donation

 :donors.spon_id:=null;
 :donors.credit_sponsor:=null;
 :global.record_no:=:system.cursor_record;


 begin
 select a.sponsor_id,b.name into v_spon_id,v_spon_name from drive_sponsors a, sponsors b
 where a.chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id and 
 a.drive_id = :donations.drive_id and
 a.sponsor_id=b.sponsor_id and rownum= 1;
 exception when others then
 v_spon_id:=null;
 v_spon_name:=null;
 end;

 if v_spon_name is not null then
 :donors.drive_sponsor := v_spon_id || ' [' || v_spon_name || ']';
 else
 :donors.drive_sponsor := '[' || v_spon_id || ']';
 end if;
 :donors.drive_sponsor := '[' || :donations.drive_id || ']-' || :donors.drive_sponsor;
 -- get credit sponsor name is a credit sponsor is available

 if :donations.credit_sponsor is not null then
 :donors.spon_id:=:donations.credit_sponsor;
 --:donations.dummy_unit_id := nvl(:donations.unit_id, 'DEF[' || :donations.deferral_id || ']' ); -- Commented by Kishore on 12/07/2015. SCR 21559

 begin
 select name into v_cre_spon_name from sponsors b
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id and 
 sponsor_id=:donations.credit_sponsor and rownum= 1;
 exception when others then
 v_cre_spon_id:=null;
 v_cre_spon_name:=null;
 end;


 if v_cre_spon_name is not null then
 :donors.credit_sponsor := v_cre_spon_name || ' [' ||:donations.credit_sponsor || ']';
 else
 :donors.credit_sponsor := '[' || :donations.credit_sponsor || ']';
 end if;
 end if;

-- message( :donations.transaction_id ); pause;
 :donors.msg_box := null;
 -- :donors.msg_box := 'Last Interface ' || to_char( sysdate, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI:SS' );
 -- get the Lab Unit Interdiction details
 if :donations.unit_id is not null 
 and :donations.coll_date is not null then
 go_block('lab_unit_interdictions');
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=10;

 -- get the Units status
 declare
 dtLocalDate Date;
 begin
 select donor_lab_dats
 into dtLabDt
 from units
 where unit_id = :donations.unit_id 
 and coll_date = :donations.coll_date 
 and rownum = 1;
 dtLocalDate := get_local_date(dtLabDt);
 --:donors.msg_box := 'Last Interface ' || to_char( dtLocalDate, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI:SS' ); -- IM 51
 :donors.msg_box := ' Last ' || CHR(10) || ' Interface ' || CHR(10) || ' ' || to_char( dtLocalDate, 'MM-DD-YY' ) || CHR(10) || ' ' || to_char( dtLocalDate, 'HH24:MI:SS' ); -- IM 51
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :donors.msg_box := 'No Donor-Lab Interface';
 when others then
 null;
 end;
 go_block('donations');
 if :global.move_record='Y' then 
 go_record(:global.rec_no);
 :global.move_record:='N';
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 szSponID varchar2(10);
 szSponName varchar2(50);
 v_curr_rec varchar2(1);

 cursor cur_spon_name (p_spon_id varchar2) is
 select name
 from sponsors
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and sponsor_id = p_spon_id;

 cursor cur_spon (p_drive_id varchar2) is
 select sponsor_id
 from drive_sponsors
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and drive_id = p_drive_id
 and rownum = 1;

begin

/****

 :global.record_no:=:system.cursor_record;

 -- :donations.dummy_unit_id := nvl(:donations.unit_id, 'DEFERRED');
 :donations.dummy_unit_id := nvl(:donations.unit_id, 'DEF[' || :donations.deferral_id || ']' );
:donors.spon_id:=null;
:donors.credit_sponsor:=null;

 -- get drive sponsor and alternate sponsor id for this donation
 open cur_spon(:donations.drive_id);
 fetch cur_spon 
 into szSponID;
 if cur_spon%NOTFOUND then
 szSponID := null;
 end if;
 if cur_spon%isopen then
 close cur_spon;
 end if;

 -- now get the drive sponsor name
 if szSponID is not null then
 open cur_spon_name(szSponID);
 fetch cur_spon_name 
 into szSponName;
 if cur_spon_name%NOTFOUND then
 szSponName := null;
 end if;
 if cur_spon_name%isopen then
 close cur_spon_name;
 end if;
 if szSponName is not null then
 :donors.drive_sponsor := szSponName || ' [' || szSponID || ']';
 else
 :donors.drive_sponsor := '[' || szSponID || ']';
 end if;
 :donors.drive_sponsor := '[' || :donations.drive_id || ']-' || :donors.drive_sponsor;
 end if;

 -- get credit sponsor name is a credit sponsor is available
 if :donations.credit_sponsor is not null then
 :donors.spon_id:=:donations.credit_sponsor;
 open cur_spon_name(:donations.credit_sponsor);
 fetch cur_spon_name 
 into szSponName;
 if cur_spon_name%NOTFOUND then
 szSponName := null;
 end if;
 if cur_spon_name%isopen then
 close cur_spon_name;
 end if;
 if szSponName is not null then
 :donors.credit_sponsor := szSponName ;
 else
 null; 
 end if;
 end if;

****** not being used */

 if :donations.note_id is not null then 
 :donors.note_indicator:='!';
 else
 :donors.note_indicator:=null;
 end if;

--pitss synchronize;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 szChkDgt varchar2(3);
 szVoidChkDgt varchar2(2);
 szDonorID varchar2(10) := :parameter.p_donor_id; -- Added by Kishore on 07/22/2013, SCR 19639
 t_status_flag online_status.status_flag%type;
Begin
 IF :DONATIONS.unit_id is not null OR :DONATIONS.deferral_id is not null THEN
 if length(:donations.unit_id)=13 then 
 VALIDATE_UNIT_CHKDIGIT(:donations.unit_id,szChkDgt);
 end if;
 :donations.dummy_unit_id := nvl(:donations.unit_id||LTrim(szChkDgt),'DEF[' || :donations.deferral_id || ']' );
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 07/22/2013. SCR 19639
 begin
 select void_unit_id
 into :donations.s_void_unit_id
 from donations
 where transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id
 and chapter_id = :donations.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('16217');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 -- End of change
 if NVL(length(:donations.s_void_unit_id), 0) >= 13 then
 validate_unit_chkdigit(:donations.s_void_unit_id, szVoidChkDgt); -- Added by Kishore on 08/05/2013. IM 9552
 :donations.s_void_chk_digit := szVoidChkDgt; -- Added by Kishore on 08/05/2013. IM 9552
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 12/18/2014. IM 10302
 else -- Added by Kishore on 07/22/2013. SCR 19639
 -- Added by Kishore on 07/22/2013. SCR 19639
 if :donations.unit_id is null then
 begin
 select status_flag
 into t_status_flag
 from online_status
 where transaction_id = :donations.transaction_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_status_flag := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if upper(nvl(t_status_flag, '*')) = 'W' then
 :donations.dummy_unit_id := 'WALK';
 end if;
 -- End of change
 end if;
 -- End of change
 END IF;
End;

--

--

-- Begin default relation program section
--

 END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 cursor phy_code (pl_equip_ref in varchar2) is select physical_code from physical_findings where 
 transaction_id=:donations.transaction_id and (nvl(equip_reference,' ') = pl_equip_ref OR nvl(equip_reference_repeat,' ') = pl_equip_ref)
 order by physical_code;
 
 phy_code_string varchar2(100);
Begin
 :temp_qc_status:=nvl(:QC_STATUS,'No QC');
 
 If :EQUIP_SUPPLY.EQUIP_REFERENCE is not null then 
 phy_code_string:=null;
 
 FOR Z in phy_code(:EQUIP_SUPPLY.EQUIP_REFERENCE) loop
 phy_code_string:= phy_code_string||Z.physical_code||' ,';
 END LOOP;
 :phy_code:=phy_code_string;
 if substr(phy_code_string,-1) = ',' then 
 :phy_code:=substr(phy_code_string,1, length(phy_code_string)-1);
 end if;
 
 Else
 Null; 
 End IF; 
End;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

declare
 msg number;
begin
 select count(msg_id)
 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;
